_comment: Sources still pointing upstream because GitHub refuses to create the fork.
check_fork_only.py reads this file and downgrades these to a NAMED, DATED
exception instead of a hard failure. It is deliberately not a silent
allowlist: each entry carries an expiry, and the check FAILS on an expired
one. An exception with no expiry is how a temporary state becomes permanent.
PDK data counts (owner, 2026-07-29). The PDK entries below are used by every
DRC and LVS run; see docs/TOOL_INVENTORY.md Table C, which exists because
neither tool table can see PDK data at all.
To clear an entry: fork it into vibeic/, add it to fork-gatekeeper's
FORKS.json, point the Dockerfile at the fork, and delete the entry here.
